entities.name: Paul B. Johnson Jr.

entities.summary: Paul Burney Johnson Jr. was an American attorney and Democratic politician from Mississippi, serving as the 54th governor from January 1964 until January 1968. He was a son of former Mississippi Governor Paul B. Johnson Sr.
